title: Guarded portal facility under Forest Service cover

tellings.quote: There is a portal in the United States.

plain: "There is a portal in the United States," the story goes: a guarded facility at Bradshaw Ranch in Arizona, hidden behind the cover of the US Forest Service, the agency that manages national forests. The Australian investigative journalist Ross Coulthart passes this on from what he was told by a source he does not name.
